description: All three windows listen for events and none is given anything else. The pill calls one thing, `finish`, from its ✓ and ✕ buttons — see the contract at the top of app/ui/pill.js — and otherwise only listens. The first-run and settings windows call commands this app defines itself (`start_download`, `hotkey_label`, `settings_get`, `settings_set`), which need no permission here because self-defined commands are not gated by capabilities; only core and plugin ones are.
